text:
Talia Benson: Hey all — pushing the launch brief into "ready to execute" today. Need final owner assignments + dates for the remaining launch tasks so I can lock the checklist + comms. Please reply in-thread with what you own + ETA.

Scope reminders for v1:
- Python + TS RAG+agent templates
- CLI: `init` + `doctor` (no in-place upgrade story for v1)
- observability pack dashboards + recommended alerts
- docs IA + walkthrough + troubleshooting
- support enablement + announcement

Owner buckets we need to nail:
1) Docs updates (IA/nav, walkthrough, troubleshooting)
2) Dashboard pack (publish + verify)
3) Template release (repo tags, changelog, version stamps)
4) Support enablement (runbook, FAQ, escalation route)
5) Announcement (internal + external)

Also: any "must fix" blockers discovered in internal beta that are still open, please flag.

Alex Martinez: :eyes: following. Want owners + dates by EOD so we can confirm support coverage.

Monica Patel: I can own (3) template release coordination across repos. Connor for final tagging/versioning, but I’ll drive the checklist + gating. ETA: release candidate cut by Wed, final tag Thu AM PT.

Connor O'Brien: Yep. I’ll own the mechanics: version number, `TEMPLATE_VERSION` stamp, tags, and changelog format. Need final merged SHAs by Wed 3pm PT. If we miss, we slip.

Elliot Price: I’ll own (1) docs updates. Wei and I split pages:
- IA/nav + landing page: me
- RAG+agent walkthrough: Wei
- troubleshooting/common errors: me (with support input)
ETA: PRs ready for review Tuesday; merge by Thursday morning.

Wei Chen: Confirmed. I can get walkthrough to "ready for eng review" by late Monday if no new API changes. Need final decisions on telemetry tagging wording (opt-in) so I don’t have to rewrite.

Logan Wright: For telemetry tagging: requirement is opt-in header + no user content. I’ll drop final language in the brief today. (Also confirm whitelist is live behind gateway.)

Allison Grant: I’ll own (2) dashboard pack publish checklist + verifying metric names match the template standard. Sergio is implementing the actual dashboards/alerts PRs, but I’ll do final schema review + sign-off.
ETA: sign-off by Wed, publish by Thu.

Sergio Costa: Ack. I’ll own the actual dashboard JSON + alert rules merge in observability-pack + the "how to import" notes. Have one remaining question: do we ship alerts disabled by default? (I vote yes.)

Christine Wong: +1 to disabled by default. For (4) support enablement: I can review the runbook + resilience/failure modes sections (timeouts, retries, streaming reconnect) and sanity check alert thresholds so we don’t recommend noisy defaults. Not owning the whole support thing, but I’ll sign off.

Dev Patel: I’ll own (4) support enablement. Deliverables:
- internal runbook page (top issues + playbooks)
- support macro snippets (401/429/otel exporter auth/streaming disconnect)
- escalation route (who’s on point week 1)
ETA: draft runbook by Wed, final by Fri.

Priya Shah: I’ll help Dev with the macros + "top tickets" list. Also propose we add 5 screenshots to the troubleshooting doc (common error output + where to look in logs). Elliot lmk if you want those.

Elliot Price: Yes please. Screenshots help a lot. Send by Wed and I’ll incorporate.

Renee Sullivan: I can own (5) announcement content (internal + external blog/social draft) with Alex review. Need final date/time + canonical links (docs landing + GitHub repo + CLI install). ETA: internal announcement ready Thu; external draft ready Fri.

Alex Martinez: I’ll review announcement + messaging. Let’s do internal announcement same day docs merge, then external early next week once we confirm no fire drills.

Talia Benson: Great. Mapping owners now. Quick clarification requests:
- Sergio/Allison: confirm where dashboards are published (observability-pack release tag?) and any doc link needed.
- Monica/Connor: what are the release gates (CI smoke tests, security scan green, etc.)?
- Dev: please confirm escalation list (DevEx oncall? channel?).

Sergio Costa: Publish plan: merge to `observability-pack` main, cut a release tag `templates-v1.0` (or similar), then docs link to "install dashboards" page. We also include local dev collector config in the template repo already.

Allison Grant: + we’ll verify metrics cardinality. No high-card tags (no prompt text, no user ids). Span attrs limited to model, route, template_version, error_category.

Monica Patel: Release gates proposal:
- CI: streaming/tool smoke tests passing (2 consecutive runs)
- security scan workflow green (deps pinned)
- `doctor` passes locally on macOS + Linux runner
- template README check: safe defaults + troubleshooting present
- telemetry header feature flag default OFF

Connor O'Brien: + Tagging policy: we tag template repo and CLI release together. Docs point to "latest" but recommend pinning by tag for teams.

Dev Patel: Escalation:
- #help-templates for week 1 (monitored by DevEx + Support)
- Eng escalation via Monica (primary) + Dana (secondary)
- SRE concerns -> Christine
I’ll put that into runbook.

Talia Benson: Awesome. Here’s the owner list as of now — react with :thumbsup: if accurate or reply with changes.

(1) Docs updates
- Owner: Elliot (lead), Wei (walkthrough)
- Support inputs: Priya
- Due: PRs Tue, merge Thu

(2) Dashboard pack
- Owner: Sergio (implementation), Allison (standards/sign-off), Christine (SRE review)
- Due: sign-off Wed, publish Thu

(3) Template release
- Owner: Monica (coord), Connor (versioning/tagging)
- Due: RC Wed, final tag Thu AM

(4) Support enablement
- Owner: Dev (lead), Priya (macros)
- Review: Christine
- Due: runbook Wed draft, final Fri

(5) Announcement
- Owner: Renee (draft), Alex (final review)
- Due: internal Thu, external Fri draft

Alex Martinez: :thumbsup:

Monica Patel: :thumbsup: Only note: if TS SDK streaming fix doesn’t land by Wed, TS template may have to ship with "known limitations" section. Dana is on it.

Wei Chen: :thumbsup: Once Logan drops telemetry language I’ll finalize that section.

Allison Grant: :thumbsup:

Sergio Costa: :thumbsup: Will ship alerts disabled by default + include “how to enable safely” notes.

Christine Wong: :thumbsup: Please make sure we explicitly say "retry budget" and "max streaming reconnect attempts" in runbook.

Dev Patel: :thumbsup: I’ll add a quick “what info to include in tickets” section (request id, template version, proxy info).

Renee Sullivan: :thumbsup: Please confirm what we’re calling this publicly — “Quickstart Templates” vs “Starter Kits”.

Elliot Price: Docs uses “Quickstart Templates”. Consistent with nav.

Alex Martinez: Agree. “Quickstart Templates” externally. Internally we can keep calling them templates.

Talia Benson: Cool. I’ll update the launch brief + calendar hold. Next check-in: Wed 10am PT for go/no-go on RC.

Monica Patel: Also: please don’t forget to update the CLI `doctor` output to point to the troubleshooting URL (once Elliot has the final slug). That’s an easy support deflection win.

Elliot Price: Noted — I’ll post the final URL slug in this thread once the docs PR is up.

Talia Benson: Perfect. Closing loop here; I’ll DM folks if anything slips.
